latestVersion.changelog:
web-to-excel 1.0.0 - Initial release

- Allows users to extract structured data from any webpage and populate specified ranges in any Excel file.
- All parameters, URLs, file paths, and field mappings are provided by the user at runtime (not hardcoded).
- Supports confirmation workflow, including field mapping preview and user verification.
- Handles web pages with lazy loading content; scrolls to ensure complete data extraction.
- On repeat extraction, can optionally clear existing data before filling new data.
- Provides clear prompts, step-by-step instructions, and a report summarizing updated rows and columns.
